mapper.select:
select c1.C_Name as pecConstructionUnitName, c2.C_Name as pecUnitName, sd.D_Name as pecDepartmentName, c1.C_Abbreviation as pecConstructionAbbName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId,
from Pe_Info_Collect pec left join Sys_Company c1 on pec.pec_Construction_Unit_Id=c1.C_Id left join Sys_Company c2 on pec.Pec_Unit_Id=c2.C_Id left join Sys_Department sd on pec.Pec_Department=sd.D_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=pec.pec_Id where pec.Pec_Id=#{pecId}
mapper.sql: pec.pec_Id as pecId, pec.pec_Date as pecDate, pec.pec_Uid as pecUid, pec.pec_Uname as pecUname, pec.pec_Construction_Unit_Id as pecConstructionUnitId, pec.Pec_Unit_Id as pecUnitId, pec.Pec_Flow_Date as pecFlowDate, pec.Pec_Flow_State as pecFlowState, pec.Pec_Remark as pecRemark, pec.Pec_Year as pecYear, pec.Pec_Quarter as pecQuarter, pec.Pec_Type as pecType, pec.Pec_Department as pecDepartment
